notes.title: Four Is A Party Update
notes.notes:
Hello clones!

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/fourisaparty]Four is a Party[/url] multi-player celebration is now live and [b]R.I.S.E[/b] is being showcased along with a bunch of other great multiplayer games!

If you stumbled on our game from the event, hello! We are the developers of [b]R.I.S.E.[/b] Our game is a dark, action roguelike with bullet hell mechanics that takes place in a never-ending cyberpunk arena of death. Together in [b]Co-Op[/b] mode with your friends (or alone, if want) you will climb the floors of an arena tower, fighting hordes of aliens and robots until your death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44973982/e407af7123df4cbe0427d3dc465dfbaa7072c1fb.gif[/img]
Once you die, your clone will respawn, and you will do it all again. If you want to know what our game is all about, here is a quick rundown!
[list]
[*] Take on the arena alone or play co-op with your friends. You can play with up to 4 players!
[*] Multiple playable classes with unique weapons and armor that change their playstyle. You have the freedom to switch classes easily between runs without losing progress.
[*] Every tower you encounter is procedurally generated. There are endless new combinations of challenging floors, resulting in different experiences every run.
[*] When you level up, you get a choice to power up your skills to further define your playstyle.
[*] Jump right into gameplay. Don’t get bogged down with lore dumps or long cutscenes. Return to a time where games were just games and enjoy co-op gameplay with your friends.
[/list]
Please considering [b]Wishlisting [/b]us here on Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903890/RISE/

If you have any questions for the developers, feel free to leave a comment here or join our [url=https://discord.gg/sGRbJ3xfAP]Discord[/url] where you can talk to us directly!

Get ready to party,
The R.I.S.E Team

notes.title: Bullet Heaven Update
notes.notes:
Hello clones!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/bulletheaven2]The Bullet Heaven 2.0 Festival is now live ![/url] We are excited for [b]R.I.S.E[/b] to be showcased among a group of amazing games.

If you have found our game from the event, welcome!

[b]R.I.S.E[/b] is a dark, action roguelike with bullet hell mechanics that takes place in a never-ending cyberpunk arena of death. You will climb the floors of an arena tower, fighting hordes of aliens and robots until your death.

Once you die, your clone will respawn, and you will do it all again. Here is a quick rundown of some of our core mechanics.
[list]
[*] Multiple playable classes with unique weapons and armors to augment their playstyle. If you don’t like a class, switch easily between runs.
[*] Take on the arena alone or play co-op with your friends.
[*] Every tower is procedurally generated. This allows for endless new combinations of our hand-crafted floors, resulting in different challenges every time you go on a run.
[*] When you level up during a run, you can choose to power up your skills to further define your playstyle. Upgrading a weapon’s attack speed can have you slicing through hordes of enemies or upgrading their range can mean one swipe taking out groups of mobs all at once.
[*] Jump right into gameplay. Don’t get bogged down with lore dumps or long cutscenes. Return to a time where games were just games!
[/list]

Please considering [b]Wishlisting [/b]us here on Steam! If you have any questions for the developers, feel free to leave a comment here or join our [url=https://discord.gg/sGRbJ3xfAP]Discord[/url] where you can talk to us directly!

Stay sharp,
The R.I.S.E Team
